title: Synergistic intragenic epigenetic deregulation by IDH2 and SRSF2 mutations causes mis-splicing of key transcriptional regulators.
authors: Telonis, Aristeidis G; Stanley, Robert F; Adelman, Emmalee R; Yoshimi, Akihide; Adele, Adedamola A; Cruz, Angelique; Wiseman, Daniel H; Abdel-Wahab, Omar; Figueroa, Maria E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IDH2/SRSF2突变协同导致DNA甲基化与剪接失调，虽用机器学习预测外显子包含水平，但核心是表观遗传与剪接调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅间接相关。
abstract: Genes affecting DNA methylation (DNAme) are frequently comutated with splicing factors in acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and associate with more aggressive phenotypes. To elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms, we deeply profiled wild-type and IDH2(R140Q)/SRSF2(P95) single- or double-mutant AMLs. We find a unique set of mis-spliced genes and differentially methylated CpGs in double mutants. Mis-spliced exons are enriched in CCNG splicing enhancers and in the corresponding DNAme changes. Using a machine learning model, we can accurately predict exon inclusion levels from proximal CpGs. These CpGs are more likely to overlap footprints of RNA binding and chromatin-modifying complexes but not transcription factors. We also report unique gene expression profiles associated with each genotype; however, the differentially expressed genes do not overlap with mis-spliced transcripts. Instead, the mis-spliced genes encode for proteins that interact with the complexes regulating these differentially expressed genes. Thus, aberrant DNAme and splicing lead to the mis-splicing of key regulatory complexes, resulting in the aberrant gene expression profiles characteristic of these AMLs.
abstract_zh: 影响DNA甲基化（DNAme）的基因在急性髓系白血病（AML）中常与剪接因子共突变，并与更具侵袭性的表型相关。为阐明其潜在分子机制，我们对野生型及IDH2(R140Q)/SRSF2(P95)单突变或双突变AML进行了深度分析。我们在双突变体中发现了一组独特的错误剪接基因和差异甲基化CpG位点。错误剪接的外显子富集于CCNG剪接增强子及相应的DNAme变化区域。利用机器学习模型，我们能够从邻近CpG位点准确预测外显子包含水平。这些CpG更可能重叠RNA结合和染色质修饰复合物的足迹，而非转录因子的足迹。我们还报告了与每种基因型相关的独特基因表达谱；然而，差异表达基因与错误剪接转录本并无重叠。相反，错误剪接基因编码的蛋白质与调控这些差异表达基因的复合物相互作用。因此，异常的DNAme和剪接导致关键调控复合物的错误剪接，从而产生这些AML特征性的异常基因表达谱。
